title: Preliminary peak stage and streamflow data for selected U.S. Geological Survey streamgaging stations in North and South Carolina for flooding following Hurricane Florence, September 2018
citation: Feaster, T.D., Weaver, J.C., Gotvald, A.J., and Kolb, K.R., 2018, Preliminary peak stage and streamflow data for selected U.S. Geological Survey streamgaging stations in North and South Carolina for flooding following Hurricane Florence, September 2018: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2018-1172, map scale 1:2,800,000.
notes:
Flood report (peak stage and streamflow after Hurricane Florence, North and South Carolina); streamflow, rainfall and flood-frequency values are not geology and were not recorded. Only the study-area statement on South Carolina Coastal Plain sediment thickness (page 11, citing Badr and others, 2004) and the two South Carolina geology/water references recorded. North Carolina Coastal Plain wedge statement not recorded (North Carolina). Physiographic elevations (Blue Ridge, Piedmont, Sand Hills) not recorded.
Pages 31-44: rest of the reference list (flood, climate and streamflow-method references; no geology references) and table 1 of streamgage peak stages and streamflows (streamflow data, not geology). Nothing recorded.
